definitions.explanation: the period of heavy traffic congestion when people commute to work, typically in the morning

examples.japanese: {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュを{避|さ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to avoid the commuter rush.

examples.japanese: {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュの{電車|でんしゃ}は{地獄|じごく}だ。
examples.english: The train during rush hour is hell.

examples.japanese: フレックスタイムで{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュを{避|さ}けられる。
examples.english: With flextime, I can avoid the commuter rush.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{通勤|つうきん} (commuting) + ラッシュ (rush, from English)

TIMING:
Typically refers to:
- 7:30-9:00 AM in major Japanese cities
- Peak congestion on trains can reach 180-200% capacity

CONTRAST:
- {通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ (morning rush) ↔ {帰宅|きたく}ラッシュ (evening rush)

RELATED:
- {満員電車|まんいんでんしゃ} - packed train
- {時差出勤|じさしゅっきん} - staggered commuting hours
- ラッシュアワー - rush hour
- {混雑|こんざつ} - congestion
